content:
The top envelope band reads back as a deep red color (0.85, 0.15, 0.12), which is what I based the "red" description on — that read-back is what I saw, not an assumption. The chosen hot air balloon is placed in the world with its red envelope, dark crown cap, wooden basket with sandbags, four connecting ropes, and a flickering burner flame. I haven't visually re-confirmed the final framing after the envelope was raised — the basket and ropes are confirmed present by their positions, but not by a fresh screenshot.

What I did not check: that the color is deep red.
